title: Celebrity Pulls Driver from Burning Car
main_content:
Actor Jamie Foxx won an Academy Award for playing singer Ray Charles in the film “Ray.”

Foxx is famous for his work in movies, his jokes in stand-up comedy routines and even for recording songs.

Foxx saved a man from a burning car.

Thirty-two-year-old Brett Kyle drove a truck off the road in front of Foxx’s home in California. The truck hit a ditch and reportedly turned over several times.

The truck caught fire and Foxx ran out of his home to help.

He pulled the driver out of the truck and to safety.

Kyle was taken to the hospital for treatment of serious injuries. He also was arrested for drunken driving.

Foxx met with the man’s father.

People had only good things to say about Foxx for doing a good deed.

And Foxx added a photo to Instagram. It shows him hugging Kyle’s father.

Foxx wrote: “This is all that matters. That a man, a son, a brother’s life was spared last night.”

questions.question: What was Jamie Foxx famous for before this deed?
options: A) His philanthropic efforts in the community
B) His work in movies, stand-up comedy, and music
C) His athletic achievements in college sports
D) His participation in reality television shows
questions.answer: B) His work in movies, stand-up comedy, and music

questions.question: How did Jamie Foxx help the truck driver?
options: A) He called the police for assistance
B) He pulled the driver out of the burning truck
C) He provided first aid at the scene
D) He offered emotional support after the incident
questions.answer: B) He pulled the driver out of the burning truck

questions.question: Why was Brett Kyle arrested?
options: A) For speeding before the accident
B) For public intoxication near the accident site
D) For failing to provide insurance information
